decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to occupation and notwithstanding the details submitted with the application, full details of cycle parking shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This
shall demonstrate compliance with policy T5 of the London Plan and the London
Cycling Design Standards. </p><p class="MsoNormal">The cycle parking shall be implemented in accordance
with the approved details prior to occupation and shall thereafter be
maintained for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><i>Reason: To encourage active modes of transportation and
to comply with policy T5 of the London Plan.</i><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to occupation and notwithstanding the details submitted with the application, full details of refuse storage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal">The refuse storage shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation and shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the development.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.
Prior to first occupation, the outbuilding as shown in drawing no. W5-08a dated Jan 2024 shall be fully demolished.
The upper floor side facing windows shall be obscure glazed and non-opening below 1.7m.

Prior to occupation, a scheme for protecting future residential occupants from external air quality shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where the development is within an AQMA and Air Quality Focus Area with existing levels of pollutants being at, above or close to national limit values for nitrogen dioxide (NO2), the scheme shall include mechanical ventilation designed to safeguard occupants from the ingress of the poor outdoor air quality. The design must consider climate change pollutants and ensure there are no trade-offs between local and global pollutant emissions. Suitable ventilation systems will need to take air from a clean location or treat the air and remove pollutants, be designed to minimise energy usage, be sufficient to prevent summer overheating and have robust arrangements for maintenance. Any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the
development is first occupied or used and measures put in place to ensure it is maintained for the life of the development.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>Plans - W5-01a - Jan 2024</p><p>Plans - W5-02a - Jan 2024</p><p>Plans - W5-03a - Jan 2024</p><p>Elevations - W5-04a - Jan 2024</p><p>Elevations - W5-05a - Jan 2024</p><p>Elevations - W5-06a - Jan 2024</p><p>Elevations - W5-07a - Jan 2024<br></p><p>Roof Plans - W5-08a - Jan 2024</p><p>Block Plans - W5-08a - Jan 2024</p><p>Location Plan - 29/01/2024</p><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
description:

habitable accommodation
